Cardholders can earn reward points on all spends, including generally excluded categories like rent, education and insurance. Unlimited lounge access, zero forex mark-up fee and complimentary hotel memberships make this card a good option for frequent travellers. Note: This is an invite-only card. Content on this page is for information only._

faqs.q: What is the annual fee waiver condition for IDFC FIRST Private Credit Card?
faqs.a: The card does not offer spend-based annual fee waiver.

faqs.q: I have IDFC FIRST Wealth Credit Card. Can I upgrade it to IDFC FIRST Private?
faqs.a: You can get IDFC FIRST Private Credit Card only if you get an invite from the bank. Existing IDFC FIRST Bank customers who have shown responsible credit usage may be considered. Since IDFC FIRST Wealth is also a high-end option and comes with high income eligibility, Wealth cardholders could be more likely to get an invite. You can speak to your relationship manager to get more clarity on this.

faqs.q: How to avail golf benefit with IDFC FIRST Private Credit Card?
faqs.a: To book your golf round/lesson, you have to visit https://idfcfirst.truztee.com/. Use your registered email ID and OTP to login to the website. Select the golf course of your choice and make the booking.

faqs.q: Can I use this card for insurance premium payment?
faqs.a: Yes. You can use this card and earn 1 reward point for every Rs. 100 spent for insurance premium payment.

faqs.q: What is the limit of IDFC Private credit card?
faqs.a: The credit limit of any credit card is dependent on the cardholder’s credit profile and history, income, credit score and the card provider’s internal policies. So, there is no set limit which is offered to all the users of a similar credit card variant.

faqs.q: How to get IDFC First Private credit card?
faqs.a: IDFC FIRST Private credit card is an invite-only credit card. So, you cannot apply for it on your own. Either the bank offers this card to the eligible customers or you may also enquire about this card through your assigned relationship manager.

faqs.q: What is the eligibility of IDFC First Bank Private credit card?
faqs.a: IDFC FIRST Private credit card is a super premium invite-only card. So, only high net-worth individuals with a high credit score and good credit profile are likely to be eligible for this card. The card provider also has certain internal policies which affect the customers eligibility for any credit card.
